# Telegram Web Apps SDK

Unmodified official SDK downloaded from
https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js?57 on 2026-11-06.

File: `telegram-web-app.124bdff7.js`

SHA-256: `124bdff7ba3fe86c8ba5143467afec21e020405e74abdb92cfdda6c0ee3b5908`

The app serves this pinned copy from its own origin. A hanging request to
telegram.org must not block React hydration or the WebApp.ready() call.
When updating, keep the SDK unmodified, update its hash in the filename and
layout, and rerun startup browser checks. This file contains no bot token.
